preserveSays.line: 📖 LEARNED: Food Preservation (Level 2). Cold smoking (under 90°F) preserves without cooking. Jerky done right lasts months.

🛡️ Dawn at Haven. By the fire hangs an old bark cuirass, split at the seam — somebody's grandfather wore this into the treeline and came back. The shape of it is clear: bark plates laced overlapping like shingles, vine cord. Your hands don't know it yet. Your eyes do.
You eat Dried meat and Trail mix (1400 kcal).
You give A person, maybe 30s, with a crooked nose 3 portions of Dried beans, with the village watching. They look at you differently now.
You give A person, maybe 60s, with ink-stained fingers 3 portions of Dried beans, with the village watching. They look at you differently now.
👂 Overheard — A person, maybe 60s, with ink-stained fingers: "Good. I'll take the first rotation. Somebody has to."
👂 Overheard — A person, maybe 60s, with ink-stained fingers: "If we rotate the watch, nobody pulls two nights running. Fair's fair."
The Dried beans was off. Your stomach knots. (-5 health)
The Dried beans was off. Your stomach knots. (-5 health)
🍽️ Victor weighs the day's basket against the pantry shelves and puts it down. "Enough. Carving bowls instead — we're down to the cracked ones."
🍽️ Pearl carries the day's surplus to the pantry door, thinks better of it, and turns back to the fire. "It'll only rot in there. We eat."
The woman in her 50s looks at the pantry, then at the Codex, then at you. "We’re going to make it." Haven will survive — because someone learned the land, and wrote it down. One less thing to fear.
"So we made it OFFICIAL! The PARTY SYSTEM! Up to THREE companions! Formal! Tracked! With a UI! The audience can see your party composition now! Very important for the betting markets!"
★ IDENTIFIED: Bael. (bel). The hard-shelled fruit — crack it like a coconut. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
SYSTEM: Quest protocol integrated. Objectives will appear.
A cold snap. Breath smokes. The woods go quiet.
👁 Wary. Ears always tracking. Get close before it knows you're there.

Weerachai leans in, voice low. "Here's what we figured out about The Anaconda Empress. Strike the head as it coils. When the coils start to wrap, don't pull away — strike the head and eyes. It will release to protect them. On land it is slow and heavy; it needs the water to be the Empress. Never let it get a second wrap."

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Anaconda Empress: Strike the head as it coils. When the coils start to wrap, don't pull away — strike the head and eyes. It will release to protect them. 🍽️ Ingrid taps the pantry's fullest jar. "More than we can eat before it turns. Rendering fat instead — the lamps won't fill themselves."
💡 KNOWLEDGE COMBINES: Hickory Nuts — Level 2. You knew it was safe. the village knew the rest. Together, it's deeper. Parts: nut meat (eat), shells (smoke flavor), bark (tea). Crack carefully.

🛖 Raised bins, sealed lids, clay and cool dark. The granary stands full of food that waits — smoked, dried, rendered, patient. Whatever comes, Haven eats a while longer.
